answer: By the shale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. A knoll of per-task receipts records who did what, and the hollow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
